description: Least-privilege reader for peer conversation auto replies. libs/core/mesh/peer-auto-reply.ts assumes it, bound to the receiving tenant, to retrieve tenant knowledge (queryTenantKnowledge) that grounds an opt-in LLM reply; it reads that tenant's profile, knowledge/confidential/<tenant>/ and customer/<tenant>/ only, never knowledge/confidential/<tenant>/connections/ (peer secrets; security-policy.json deny_read), and writes nothing (persona worker). It is a tenant-bound reader (authority.ts TENANT_BOUND_READER_ROLES): the bound tenant must be explicit and equal the caller's active tenant when one exists.
